name: wp-ja-kinetic/post-topic-eyebrow
title: Post topic eyebrow
description: The blog-listing row eyebrow (`.hx-blogcat`, `category/blog_item.php:38-39`): the article's FIRST tag by assignment order (`$this->hxRowTopics`, built from `tag_date ASC`), falling back to the category title only when the article carries no tags. NOT the category — a plain `wp:post-terms(category)` (what this block replaces) shows the wrong value whenever the post has any tag.
